name: WristPane
subtitle: Apple Watch dashboard and complications
description: Development builds of WristPane for iOS 27 and watchOS 27. IPA downloads are unsigned and require appropriate device-specific signing.

apps.name: WristPane

versions.localizedDescription: Unsigned WristPane iPhone IPA with an embedded Apple Watch app and complications. This feed provides downloads, not Watch installation: the iPhone app, Watch app, and Watch widget extension require separate appropriate provisioning and signing. Normal iPhone-only FlareStore certificates cannot install the Watch companion.
